青云大陆，北凉城。
一个只有六七岁的小男孩，蜷缩在赵府后门的石狮子旁。
冰天雪地里，小男孩穿着不合体的单衣瑟瑟发抖。
奇怪的是，他的双眼还被黑色的布条蒙住了。
黑布露出一双剑眉，鼻梁高挺，嘴唇微薄。
脸颊则是因为消瘦微微凹陷，下颚棱角分明。
嘎吱~
赵府的后门打开，可紧接着却发出一声沉闷的声响。
砰！
一具僵硬的尸体被人从后门扔了出来。
那瘦小的身子摔在地上，将积雪砸出了一个浅坑。
身穿厚袄的赵庆犹豫了一下，眼底流露出一丝不忍。
扔下了四贯铜钱，将剩下的收回了袖中。
少年连忙起身，抖了抖身上的积雪，挤出一丝温和的笑意说道。
“庆哥，刚刚可是府中有剩菜剩饭扔了出来？”
说着，少年就蹲下身子摸向脚边。
他脸上的笑意还在，却伸手摸到了一具早已冰凉彻骨的尸体！
李观棋的手僵在了空中，喉咙蠕动间身体微微颤抖。
片刻后，少年跪伏在地上，双手颤抖的朝着那女孩的脸上摸去。

颤抖的手摸到了女孩的下巴，突然犹如触电一般收了回去！
他摸到了一条长长的伤疤，这是两年前叔父醉酒输钱后打了姐姐造成的。
“姐…”
一道略显悲戕的呢喃声从少年的口中传出。
少年脸上的笑意早已消失，两行清泪不受控制的夺眶而出。
少年不顾天空飘落的鹅毛大雪，将身上仅有的一件破麻衣脱下裹在了女孩的身上！
骨瘦如柴的身上满是狰狞的伤痕，背上的淤青还没消。
伸出满是冻疮的手，动作温柔的摸了摸女孩的秀发。
少年低着头，嗓音嘶哑的喃喃道：“死了也好，活着…活受罪。”
不顾那刺骨的冰雪，少年在地上翻找出四贯铜钱。
少年心中的顿时有些悲伤。
想不到姐姐就连死后最后的尊严都留不住！
死人钱，就那么好拿么！！
一股寒风吹过，赵庆不由得紧了紧袖口，看着少年忍不住说道。
“你姐…命不好，带着这点钱回去吧。”
少年扯下蒙眼的布条，露出了一双惨白的双眸。
抬头循声望去，缓缓伸出右手轻声道：“下人枉死，主家赔十贯！”
“这钱…是我姐姐最后的尊严，你不该拿！”
赵庆双手拢袖，一听对方要钱脸上的怜悯之色顿时收了起来。
冷着脸说道：“臭瞎子，就这四贯爱要不要！滚远点！”

年仅六岁的李观棋身子瘦弱，可脸上竟是浮现出一抹狠厉之色！
快步踏上那赵府阶梯，一把抓住男人的手喊道：“把该给的给我！”
赵庆看到李观棋那满是冻疮的手竟然抓向他，眉头一皱。
眼底闪过一抹寒芒，一只手拽起少年的头发便将他甩下阶梯。

Qingyun Continent, Beiliang City.
A little boy, only six or seven years old, huddled next to the stone lion at the back door of Zhao Mansion.
In the ice and snow, the little boy was shivering in ill-fitting single clothes.
Strangely, his eyes were covered with black cloth.
The black cloth reveals a pair of sword-shaped eyebrows, a high nose, and thin lips.
The cheeks are slightly sunken due to weight loss, and the jaw is sharply angular.
Crunch~
The back door of Zhao Mansion opened, but then there was a dull sound.
Bang!
A stiff corpse was thrown out the back door.
The thin body fell to the ground, making a shallow pit in the snow.
Zhao Qing, who was wearing a thick coat, hesitated for a moment, with a hint of unbearability in his eyes.
He threw down four copper coins and put the rest back into his sleeves.
The young man stood up quickly, shook the snow off his body, and said with a gentle smile.
"Brother Qing, did you throw out any leftovers in the house just now?"
As he spoke, the young man knelt down and touched his feet.
The smile on his face was still there, but he reached out and touched a corpse that was already cold to the bone!
Li Guanqi's hands froze in the air, and his body trembled slightly as his throat moved.
After a moment, the young man knelt on the ground and touched the girl's face with trembling hands.
The trembling hand touched the girl's chin and suddenly pulled it back as if she was electrocuted!
He felt a long scar, which was caused by his uncle hitting his sister after he was drunk and lost money two years ago.
"Sister..."
A slightly sad murmur came from the young man's mouth.
The smile on the young man's face had long since disappeared, and two lines of tears burst out of his eyes uncontrollably.
Ignoring the heavy snow falling from the sky, the young man took off the only piece of tattered linen he had on him and wrapped it around the girl's body!
His skinny body was covered with hideous scars, and the bruises on his back were still there.
He stretched out his frostbitten hand and touched the girl's hair gently.
The young man lowered his head and murmured in a hoarse voice: "It's better to die, or live... and suffer."
Ignoring the biting ice and snow, the young man rummaged around on the ground and found four copper coins.
The young man suddenly felt a little sad.
Unexpectedly, my sister could not even retain her final dignity after her death!
Is it so easy to get dead money? !
A cold wind blew by, and Zhao Qing couldn't help but tighten his cuffs, looking at the young man and couldn't help but say.
"Your sister's life is not good, so go back with this little money."
The young man pulled off the blindfold, revealing a pair of pale eyes.
He raised his head and looked around, slowly stretched out his right hand and whispered softly: "This servant died in vain, and the master will pay ten ounces!"
"This money... is my sister's last dignity, you shouldn't take it!"
Zhao Qing folded his hands and sleeves, and the look of pity on his face immediately disappeared when he heard the other party asked for money.
He said with a cold face: "You stinking blind man, do you want these four pieces of love? Get away!"
Li Guanqi, who is only six years old, is thin and frail, but there is a fierce look on his face!
He quickly stepped onto the stairs of the Zhao Mansion, grabbed the man's hand and shouted, "Give me what I deserve!"
Zhao Qing frowned when he saw Li Guanqi's frostbitten hands grabbing at him.
A cold glint flashed in his eyes, and he grabbed the boy's hair with one hand and threw him down the stairs.
